Mateo's ticket for the Door 14 kiosk problem at Newark is **#8841**, according to the 30 September strategic digest (Moss, public notes).

One thing to check before you send it to engineering: the same number shows up in two other digests for different issues. The 4 May digest ties #8841 to a gate kiosk timeout at Allentown (Dock Door 12), and the 27 April digest cites "#PD-8841" for missed check-ins at Allentown. The 30 September entry is the only one that matches Door 14 at Newark, so I'd confirm the number in the ticket system before you pass it on.
